calls.reason: The evidence is mixed. Akter et al. found Gemini Pro weakens on longer, complex reasoning questions, but Wang and Zhao found its commonsense reasoning competitive. Neither tests novel tasks or Ultra, so the claim isn't clearly settled.

Ultra matched GPT-4 on one coding benchmark, and a Pro-only medical study found hallucinations but also weaker results than GPT-4. Thin, partly mixed evidence from different models doesn't clearly settle comparability plus unreliability.

OpenAI's paper confirms a sensor-equipped Giiker cube in most experiments, though it also reports a vision-only setup. Nothing in the packet shows how much real-world use the system later had, so half the claim is unverified.
